purpose: Minimum observed versions / capability pins for operator tech-watch. Compared by cynic deps; upgrades go through universal ecosystem providers under human consent.

policy.pin_meaning: min_acceptable — observed below pin is status=stale; missing required is status=missing
policy.upgrade_flow: cynic deps upgrade --yes  (or --apply --confirm <token>). Channels: scripted | external | distro_managed. Principal-owned tools install as runtime user cynic.

pins.notes: Scripted provider under principal cynic: git+cmake → /var/lib/cynic/.local/bin/llama-server. desired_build for newer GGUF arches (dspark).

Optional AI env bootstrap (loose coupling). Scripted: clone Osmantic/ODS @ CYNIC_ODS_PIN (default v2.5.3) + install.sh. Attach: cynic runtime inference-discover --json [--apply]. Chat: cynic chat --ods. Native vault independent.
